description: Peak gold and the money events that character's own upload recorded. Loot, quests, vendors, and auction sales stay on the money line. Gameplay stays on its own line. A missing line is unrecorded. The difference is not called bought and is not a ban. Installs are not merged. No scan of a player who did not upload. Reads Everloot's current authorized public corpus when connected. Missing or unavailable data is reported explicitly.
name: gold_ledger

connected.description: False when no corpus was read; the page is then absent, which is not a measured zero.

dataAsOf.description: The corpus snapshot time, or null when unrecorded.

ledgers.description: One per install. Ledgers are not merged.

income.description: A category absent here was never seen: unrecorded.

incomeTotal.description: The income lines seen, summed; the difference from the peak is unrecorded, never called bought.

recorded.description: False when no snapshot and no money event names this character: gold unrecorded.

reason.description: Why nothing was read, when connected is false.

url.description: The everloot.app page that shows this answer, absolute. Absent when there is no such page or it would be empty.

title: Gold ledger for one character
